question: Why must the asvattha be cut with non-attachment?
premises: its form is not perceived here
it has no end or beginning
inference: Because the tree lacks ordinary limits, it must be severed by sharpened non-attachment.
uncertainties: sandhi split of suvirūḍhamūla- is editorial
plain_english: Its form is not perceived here thus; it has no end, no beginning, no stable foundation; this deeply rooted asvattha must be cut with the sharpened weapon of non-attachment.
